shared_elements: linear outline drawing on a flat surface
boat-like curved forms (A) vs. vessel/offering shapes (B)
justification: A shows a few sparse, highly schematic linear motifs \u2014 crescent-shaped boat-like hulls with upturned ends and a small stick-like animal or figure \u2014 scattered across an irregular rock face with no framing or ordering. B shows a formal, framed composition of two facing human figures in profile, one standing and one seated with raised arms, flanking an offering stand, above ruled registers of dense sign-writing; the only commonality is that both use reductive outline drawing, and there is no shared motif, relationship or layout.
